text: @royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager 是面向 DSH 网页端的技能管理插件。它在设置页、会话面板和工作区入口提供技能开关，并把选择按会话、工作区、全局三级保存，近层设置优先。可浏览受支持来源的技能、搜索名称或描述、批量启用或停用，也能清除某一层的覆盖。禁用项会从模型技能目录和用户调用中隐藏。适合希望分别控制项目技能与个人技能可用范围的 DSH 用户。插件通过 DSH 设置命名空间保存覆盖；代码未声明额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager manages DSH web skills at session, workspace, and global scopes. Browse or search skills, toggle them, and reset overrides. Disabled skills are hidden from the model catalog and user invocation.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager 的功能「分层技能开关」：在全局设置、工作区设置或会话面板切换技能状态；会话覆盖优先于工作区和全局设置。
@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager 的功能「技能目录过滤」：对受管理来源的技能应用有效开关；停用项不再提供给模型目录，也不能由用户调用。
@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager 的功能「技能搜索与批量操作」：在管理面板按技能名称或描述筛选列表，并对选中的多项一起启用或停用。

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager README · Required dsh patches (UX only)：Baseline: **dsh 0.1.2-alpha.2** (`master`). Enforcement no longer needs a harness merge-rule or `skill.list` wire patch. Two general-purpose UI seams are still missing upstream; apply them before a full UX match:

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager README · Required dsh patches (UX only)：| Gap | Patch |
|---|---|
| Workspace overflow has no per-entry list slot, so the plugin cannot add "Manage skills" | `patches/0001` ([Discussion #1413](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1413)) |
| Host `skills/change` is not forwarded; the `/` picker cache stays stale after a toggle | `patches/0003` |

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager README · Required dsh patches (UX only)：```bash
cd /path/to/deepseek-harness          # clean 0.1.2-alpha.2 / master
git am /path/to/dsh-plugin-skills-manager/patches/0001-feat-add-sidebar-workspaces.entry.patch
git am /path/to/dsh-plugin-skills-manager/patches/0003-fix-forward-skills-change-to-web-clients.patch
pnpm install

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager README · Required dsh patches (UX only)：- **deny-wins / `skill.list` `source`+`cwd` (old 0002)** — the plugin registers enforcement on each preset **standing layer** (same layer as `skill-filesystem`, rank 50) and lists skills through plugin HTTP (`GET /plugins/@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager/skills`).
- **lookup `sessionId` (old 0004)** — a live agent lookup already uses the Agent as `scope` (`scope.id` is the session id). A blank session's `/` menu may still list a session-disabled name until the first step; the model catalog does not.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager README · Required dsh patches (UX only)：Settings namespaces are exposed to the Web plane on 0.1.2 by registration; no expose patch is required.

Without 0001 the settings-page workspace tab still works. Without 0003, disable still hides the skill from the **model** catalog; the `/` menu and `/name` chips update only after a preset switch or reconnect.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager README · Managed sources：Only `.agents` and dsh skill roots:

| source | path | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `project-dsh` | `<project>/.dsh/skills` | dsh project dir |
| `project-agents` | `<project>/.agents/skills` | shared `.agents` |
| `user-dsh` | `$DSH_HOME/skills` | dsh user dir |
| `user-agents` | `~/.agents/skills` | user `.agents` |

Other agent trees (`.claude/skills`, `.codex/skills`, …) and `bundled`/`runtime`/`custom` are ignored. See `src/core/skill-filter.ts`.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager README · Install：The package is a **dsh profile bundle**. `dsh plugin add` reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles`.

```bash
cd dsh-plugin-skills-manager
python3 install.py install     # build + link into the profile
python3 install.py uninstall
```

`DSH_PROFILE` (default `web`), `DSH_HOME` (default `~/.dsh`).

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager README · How disable reaches the model：The three-layer store is plugin settings, not a dsh patch. On start (and when the preset roster or a standing key changes) the host:

1. `agentPresets.list()` / `standingKeyFor(id)` for every mountable preset
2. `createScope(ctx, key)` using that **same key object**
3. `registerProvider` on that scoped context (rank 50)

A remount mints a new key object; the plugin drops the old bind and registers again. Override rows in settings are unchanged.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager README · How disable reaches the model：The model catalog (`tool-skill`'s `<available_skills>`) keeps only `modelInvocable === true` entries. After the standing bind wins, a disabled name is absent from that catalog — the model never sees `foo`.

@royenheart/dsh-plugin-skills-manager README · Compatibility：| Probe | When the seam is missing | Notice |
|---|---|---|
| `sidebar.workspaces.entry` undeclared | `slots.inject` never fires; settings workspace tab remains | Silent |
| Settings namespace unavailable | Panel is read-only | Toast + banner |
| List rows have no `source` | No `.agents`/dsh filter; every discovered name is shown | Toast + banner |
| Plugin HTTP and `{ cwd }` list both fail | Workspace tab falls back to a same-cwd session, then manual names | Toast + banner |
| Standing enforcement did not win | Panel still stores overrides; banner warns the model may still see the skill | Toast + banner |
